correctness.rationale: The 11 0/1 vertices of the C5 stable-set polytope satisfy 11 complete facet inequalities. Independently enumerated 2048 facet subsets, obtaining 143 faces with f-vector (11,35,50,35,11,1); exact integer normal-cone saturation checks find 10 nonsmooth vertices, 20 nonsmooth edges, 10 nonsmooth triangles, and all 103 smooth faces unimodular. The ten maximal singular triangles are the A_i and B_i components, and independently determined pairwise intersections (10 disjoint, 20 points, 15 lines). The displayed primitive four-ray relations for the two cone orbits have full saturated rank three and yield transverse conifold uv-wz=0; the unimodular triangles give P2 orbit closures.
